question: What does SPIDER's honest end-to-end accounting need in order to become decidable, and what is the break-even reuse count on the work that can actually be measured today?
hypothesis: An end-to-end evaluation harness with frozen arm set (SPIDER inheritance with freshness gating + localized repair, B-COLD, B-INSTRUCTIONS, B-RAG-EMBED k=5, deterministic compiled executor), per-trajectory hard-reset integer counters (resolve, bind, verify, freshness, repair, browser_steps, requests, latency), family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap + block-permutation CIs, and a fail-closed arm gate (marks arm UNKNOWN when prerequisite capability absent) can be built, unit-tested, and dry-run on a deterministic scripted policy against the certified real distributed substrate. From the measurable non-token work (build, verification, serving costs), the break-even reuse count f* at which inherited execution's amortized build+verification cost is repaid can be computed, and the single measured quantity that most changes f* can be identified. Token-denominated economics are NOT_APPLICABLE and UNKNOWN until a policy-model credential exists.
falsifier: Any of: (1) the harness cannot be built with all five arms and all eight counter paths executing without error on the deterministic scripted policy; (2) the dry-run on the certified distributed substrate fails to execute end-to-end for any arm; (3) the fail-closed gate does not correctly mark arms UNKNOWN when prerequisites are absent; (4) the break-even reuse count f* cannot be computed from measured non-token work; (5) the single quantity most changing f* cannot be identified. Token economics are explicitly excluded from falsification (declared NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN).

baselines.B-COLD: Cold exploration with no inherited knowledge; per-trajectory reset counters for all eight metrics
baselines.B-INSTRUCTIONS: Static natural-language instructions only; no mechanism inheritance; same counter paths
baselines.B-RAG-EMBED: Embedding-based retrieval (TAU=0.30, QCR k=5) with honest retrieval/verify counters; 200 token retrieval + 150ms verify cost model
baselines.B-DETERMINISTIC-EXECUTOR: No-memory deterministic compiled executor (Frontier's null against SPIDER's premise); zero inheritance overhead, exact replay only; serves as primary control for inheritance value

positive_control.description: Deterministic scripted policy on certified distributed substrate executes all five arms through all eight counter paths end-to-end, with fail-closed gates marking arms UNKNOWN (never surrogate-filled, never default-filled) when prerequisites are absent. Proves instrument correctness only — NOT a scientific or product result.
positive_control.expected_behavior: All arms execute; counters increment per trajectory; bootstrap/permutation CIs compute; UNKNOWN gates fire correctly for missing BrowserGym/credentials; no arm crashes or surrogate-fills
positive_control.pass_criteria: 100% arm execution completion; zero surrogate fills; zero default fills; all eight counter paths non-zero for at least one arm; family-stratified B=5000 bootstrap + B=5000 block-permutation CIs compute without error

null_control.description: Family-stratified trajectory-grouped block permutation (B=5000) on deterministic scripted policy trajectories to verify null distribution of counter deltas and correlation structure. Shuffled rho_shuffled and rho_length must satisfy |rho|<0.20 per stratum with block-permutation p>=0.20.
null_control.expected_behavior: On deterministic scripted policy, shuffled correlations near zero; block-permutation p-values >=0.20; no deterministic coupling from counter formulas
null_control.pass_criteria: |rho_shuffled|<0.20 per stratum; block_permutation p>=0.20 per stratum; |rho_length|<0.20 per stratum

measurement_validity: Harness must execute on certified real distributed substrate (single-node HS256 sticky, n_non304>=360 stratified, TN>=0.85, WAL single-worker, ETag W/body_sha conditional probe) — already validated in EXP-PRODUCT-36095578013
All five arms must share identical model/tools/budget configuration (deterministic scripted policy for this experiment)
Per-trajectory hard reset: integer sum counters for resolve, bind, verify, freshness, repair, browser_steps, requests, latency — no jitter, no n*3200 bijective proxy, no f*6.0 scaling
Family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap (B=5000) and block-permutation (B=5000) for all CIs
Fail-closed arm gate: any arm whose prerequisite capability is absent (BrowserGym, OPENAI_API_KEY, playwright, etc.) is marked UNKNOWN — never surrogate-filled, never default-filled
Token-denominated economics explicitly NOT_APPLICABLE and UNKNOWN — no token counters, no token costs, no token Pareto claims

Break-even reuse count f* computed ONLY from measurable non-token work: build cost (mechanism distillation + registry construction), verification cost (auditor + probe), serving cost (lookup + bind + conditional fetch)

decision_rule.part_a_harness: PASS iff: all 5 arms implemented; all 8 counter paths increment per trajectory; fail-closed UNKNOWN gate implemented and tested; unit tests cover each arm + counter + gate; no surrogate/default fills in unit tests
decision_rule.part_b_dryrun: PASS iff: deterministic scripted policy executes on certified distributed substrate; all 5 arms complete; all 8 counters recorded per trajectory; bootstrap/permutation CIs compute; UNKNOWN gates fire for BrowserGym/credentials; zero crashes; zero surrogate fills; result.json explicitly states 'instrument correctness ONLY — not a scientific or product result'
decision_rule.part_c_breakeven: PASS iff: f* computed from measured build/verification/serving non-token work; single quantity most changing f* identified via sensitivity analysis; f* reported with explicit formula and measured inputs; token economics declared NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN
decision_rule.overall: EXPERIMENT COMPLETE iff all three parts PASS. Outcome = SUPPORTS if instrument decidable and f* computable; FALSIFIES if any part fails validly; MEASUREMENT_INVALID if infrastructure failure (not scientific falsification)

product_consequence_positive: If all three parts PASS: (1) Product obtains a frozen, unit-tested, dry-run-verified end-to-end accounting instrument that converts the next unblocking event (credential/substrate) into a run rather than an infrastructure cycle; (2) The break-even reuse count f* and its sensitivity are known — the decisive product number that the entire thesis turns on; (3) C-PRODUCT-ECON advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL on instrument readiness (not economics result); (4) No PRODUCT_CORE promotion — this is an instrument deliverable, not an economics result; (5) The superseded full Pareto packet (EXP-PRODUCT-36095578013) remains superseded; no further full C-PRODUCT-ECON Pareto packet frozen until Runtime capability ledger reports usable policy model and certified browser
product_consequence_negative: If any part FAILS validly (not infrastructure): (1) The specific failure mode is diagnosed (which arm, which counter, which gate, which substrate dependency); (2) The minimal fix is identified; (3) C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS with instrument gap documented; (4) Product lane does NOT retry full Pareto — the Director's mandate explicitly supersedes it; (5) Next cycle either retries the failed instrument component or PARKS product economics pending Runtime capability ledger
expected_information_gain: HIGH — This is the smallest high-information experiment that can change a product decision. It delivers the decisive instrument (decidable accounting) and the decisive number (break-even f*) without requiring any unavailable credentials or substrates. Twelve consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID C-PRODUCT-ECON packets failed because they chased Pareto economics on absent substrate. This experiment computes the amortization denominator that all twelve tried to estimate indirectly. A valid negative (instrument gap found) is still decisive — it tells exactly what must be fixed before any economics measurement can be valid. Token economics correctly declared NOT_APPLICABLE/UNKNOWN avoids the credential trap.
